name: Thraben
description: Thraben is the high holy city of Innistrad, home of the Grand Cathedral.

summary.text: Thraben is the high holy city of Innistrad, home of the Grand Cathedral.

bio.text: Liliana besieged and took the city to get at a demon, using the Chain Veil, and Thalia rode to Thraben Cathedral after witnessing atrocities at Elgaud.
Jace announced he must go to Thraben to find Avacyn, and Tamiyo drifted through its cathedral investigating why Innistrad was off its axis.
A tremor shook the cathedral, shattering its stained-glass depictions of Avacyn's face, and Sorin watched Emrakul drift toward the city.
Later, Liliana raised zombies who filled the cathedral, and Gisa rules the city from it.

status.text: As of the latest material, Thraben is a city ruled by Gisa from the cathedral, with Liliana's zombies filling it.

timeline.summary: Odric reflects in Thraben that Avacyn's return has ended the moon's power as a predictor of life and death.
timeline.quote: The phases of the moon were no longer predictors of life and death now that Avacyn had returned and cleansed the world.

timeline.summary: Grete reports no sign of Ludevic and that Gisa will be moved to Thraben, and Odric orders the escort tripled.
timeline.quote: "Triple the escort," Odric said.

timeline.summary: Grete reports that the mayor's son in Torbach died after fleeing a werewolf; Odric, doubting in his heart, orders the regiment roused.
timeline.quote: "Rouse our regiment," he told Grete.

timeline.summary: Liliana broods in her manor during a storm, recalling how she made demonic pacts and used the Chain Veil to kill demons and take Thraben.
timeline.quote: had besieged and taken Thraben itself, the greatest city on Innistrad

timeline.summary: Jace announces he must go to Thraben to find Avacyn; Liliana warns Avacyn will kill him.
timeline.quote: I have to go to Thraben,

timeline.summary: Geralf writes to Ludevic of Ulm, seeking a mentor in necromantic fabrication after his escape from Thraben to his laboratory in Trostad.
timeline.quote: I am in need of a mentor

timeline.summary: Geralf says Liliana took Mikaeus's body in Thraben and left.
timeline.quote: She took Mikaeus's body back in Thraben and absconded.

timeline.summary: Thalia rides to Thraben Cathedral, furious after witnessing atrocities at Elgaud.
timeline.quote: The ride from the Elgaud Grounds in Nephalia to Thraben Cathedral had taken days

timeline.summary: Thalia confronts Odric, demanding he stop the inquisition's burning of children at Elgaud.
timeline.quote: We're burning children now.

timeline.summary: Odric defends the purge, saying Avacyn is leading it and the church must follow her example.
timeline.quote: Avacyn is leading this purge.

timeline.summary: Thalia confides her doubt that Avacyn was corrupted by her time in the Helvault.
timeline.quote: What if her time in the Helvault corrupted her?

timeline.summary: Thalia declares she can no longer serve Avacyn and her church.
timeline.quote: I can no longer serve Avacyn and her church.

timeline.summary: Odric urges Thalia to leave Thraben and has Grete escort her beyond the wall.
timeline.quote: Will you please escort Thalia beyond the outer wall?

timeline.summary: Thalia tells Grete she will fight, even against the angels if she must.
timeline.quote: I'm going to fight,

timeline.summary: Weeks later Thalia bursts into the Lunarch Council, where Odric tells her the council has removed her title; she realizes he informed the council of her heresy.
timeline.quote: The council has removed it from you.

timeline.summary: Thalia accuses Bishop Jerren of communion with Ormendahl and of leading the Skirsdag.
timeline.quote: I bring evidence that you have been in communion with the demon Ormendahl, called the Profane Prince, and you are now the leader of the Skirsdag.

timeline.summary: Thalia presents a bloodstained letter bearing Jerren's seal giving instructions to the witch in the Profane Prince's name.
timeline.quote: The letter bears the seal and signature of none other than Bishop Jerren, giving instructions to this witch in the name of the Profane Prince!

timeline.summary: Several bishops refuse the letter until Carlin takes it and pales as she reads.
timeline.quote: Three bishops refused her as the council sat in stony silence, before Bishop Carlin took it with a quivering hand.

timeline.summary: The council calls for Thalia's execution and cathars seize her on Jerren's signal.
timeline.quote: Cathars came and seized Thalia's arms before she could draw it, looking to Jerren for direction.

timeline.summary: Odric, shaken by the council's cruelty, goes to Thalia's cell and tells the guard to open it, planning to leave with her.
timeline.quote: We are leaving here, together.

timeline.summary: Dougan and other cathars block Odric, Thalia and Grete at the stables on Jerren's orders.
timeline.quote: Stop where you stand, Lunarch Marshal,

timeline.summary: Odric disarms and wounds Dougan, and Grete kills Marta in the fight against the eight cathars.
timeline.quote: Marta, fighting on despite the wound in her shoulder, fell under Grete's heavy sword.

timeline.summary: Odric kills Haral, leaving all eight cathars bleeding or dying on the cathedral floor.
timeline.quote: The inevitable opening came, and Odric took it without thinking, slashing the man's throat open.

timeline.summary: The three escape the cathedral and leave Thraben on horseback.
timeline.quote: And they left the cathedral, then left Thraben, left their old lives far behind.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo drifts through Thraben Cathedral's chantry, investigating why Innistrad is off its axis.
timeline.quote: Despite the fact that her feet never touched the stone floor, Tamiyo thought about tiptoeing as she slowly drifted through the chantry of Thraben Cathedral.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo has come to the cathedral to study the oldest histories of Avacyn.
timeline.quote: Her latest line of research had brought her to the cathedral, where the humans of Innistrad housed their oldest histories of Avacyn.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo invokes the story He Who Frightens the Sun to blend in unseen among the cathars.
timeline.quote: The story invoked, its magic became real, and Tamiyo faded from view.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo finds a young planeswalker holding her field notes standing over a collapsed librarian.
timeline.quote: And standing over him...a Planeswalker.

timeline.summary: Jace, mad, commands her to help him; Tamiyo shields her mind and uses the story Original to calm his thoughts.
timeline.quote: But her mind withdrew to a far-off castle, and the winds could not reach her.

timeline.summary: Jace's eyes grow calm and he recovers his senses.
timeline.quote: The young human's eyes closed, and he took several deep, slow breaths.

timeline.summary: Jace introduces himself and Tamiyo asks about Jenrik, learning he did not survive Markov Manor.
timeline.quote: he didn't survive it.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo tells Jace to leave, warning that a mad telepath is a danger across planes.
timeline.quote: You need to leave, Jace.

timeline.summary: Jace offers to find out what afflicts Avacyn and stop her if necessary.
timeline.quote: I can find out what's afflicting her.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo says she is here only to understand and chronicle, and expects the plane to be doomed.
timeline.quote: I am not here to fix this world's problem. I am here to understand it.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo agrees to anchor Jace's mind if they link minds, and Jace accepts.
timeline.quote: But...in theory, I could anchor you.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo and Jace link minds, each learning the other's past and burdens.
timeline.quote: In an instant, he knew her.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo senses her veiling spell pierced as a powerful presence approaches.
timeline.quote: Jace, my veiling spell has been pierced.

timeline.summary: Avacyn arrives in the central chapel, wings bloodied and spear aflame.
timeline.quote: The angel hovered, her massive wings stained with fresh blood, her spear molten and ablaze.

timeline.summary: Avacyn brands Tamiyo an intruder and impure and attacks.
timeline.quote: Intruder. Invader. Rotmonger. Impure! IMPURE!

timeline.summary: Tamiyo fights Avacyn with the story Winter's Howl, freezing parts of her wings.
timeline.quote: Tamiyo let loose precisely targeted blasts of icy gale

timeline.summary: Avacyn freezes in place under Jace's mental assault while her light presses down on them.
timeline.quote: And then she froze.

timeline.summary: Jace learns that Avacyn is the source of the angels' madness but not its origin, and that she holds something else at bay.
timeline.quote: She's the source of the madness among the angels.

timeline.summary: Avacyn's light turns foul; she breaks free and tortures Jace.
timeline.quote: She reached down and placed her hand on his chest.

timeline.summary: Jace begs Tamiyo to read the iron scroll about Serra's realm; she refuses to open it.
timeline.quote: No, Jace. The scroll stays closed.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo tells the dying Jace that sometimes stories have to end.
timeline.quote: Sometimes, our stories have to end.

timeline.summary: Avacyn, seeing Jace and Tamiyo as demonic fiends, prepares to destroy them in Thraben Cathedral.
timeline.quote: One more gentle thrust and I will unmask these demonic creatures

timeline.summary: Avacyn blasts Tamiyo back against the wall with her light.
timeline.quote: I push toward her with my hand, and my light blasts the demon back.

timeline.summary: Sorin crashes through the skylight into the cathedral and blocks Avacyn.
timeline.quote: I look up to see the skylight explode, a man crashing through it feet first.

timeline.summary: Sorin tells Avacyn something is wrong with her and that he has come to help.
timeline.quote: There's something wrong with you, Avacyn

timeline.summary: Avacyn hurls holy magic at Sorin twice, but he is unharmed.
timeline.quote: I hurl the holy magic at him, and it hits him full in the chest.

timeline.summary: Sorin reveals he is Avacyn's creator, which is why she cannot harm him.
timeline.quote: I am your creator

timeline.summary: Avacyn recognizes Sorin as the reason she exists, who gave her mission to protect.
timeline.quote: He is the reason I exist.

timeline.summary: Avacyn sees images of burning villages and slain innocents and realizes she herself set the fires.
timeline.quote: I have set those fires. I have slain those innocents.

timeline.summary: Avacyn condemns Sorin as the greatest evil of the world for creating her flawed.
timeline.quote: Sorin Markov, I condemn you as the greatest evil of this world.

timeline.summary: Avacyn lunges at Sorin with her spear but misses him.
timeline.quote: I lunge with the spear, using every bit of my divine strength.

timeline.summary: Avacyn summons the angels from the rafters to attack Sorin.
timeline.quote: He looks up to see the angels I have called down on him.

timeline.summary: Sorin destroys Avacyn's angels one by one, draining one.
timeline.quote: One by one he destroys my angels.

timeline.summary: Avacyn, seeing Sorin as a monster, can finally harm him and slashes his neck.
timeline.quote: I slash my spear through his neck, cutting deep enough to hit bone.

timeline.summary: Avacyn drives her spear through Sorin's chest plate and into the wall.
timeline.quote: I sink my spear through the gap in the monster's chest plate, so deep that the blade hits the granite of the cathedral wall on the other side.

timeline.summary: Sorin reveals his full strength, pins Avacyn and bites her neck.
timeline.quote: He bites my neck, and the pain is like a thousand innocents screaming

timeline.summary: Sorin drives Avacyn through the cathedral floor into the cellar where she was made.
timeline.quote: When we slam to a halt, we lie in the cellar of Thraben Cathedral

timeline.summary: Sorin offers to cleanse her mind and remake her; Avacyn refuses to be anyone's instrument.
timeline.quote: I am no monster's instrument. I will not be altered by the likes of you.

timeline.summary: Sorin destroys Avacyn by performing a ritual in reverse, revoking his gift, and she dies with a final prayer.
timeline.quote: words of a ritual performed in reverse, words of a gift being revoked.

timeline.summary: Jace demands to know what Sorin has done as Avacyn is gone, leaving the cathedral vacant.
timeline.quote: Avacyn was no more. The cathedral felt overly large now, somehow.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo warns of consequences and says the plane has lost its protector as the world shakes.
timeline.quote: The plane has lost its protector

timeline.summary: A tremor shakes the cathedral, shattering stained-glass depictions of Avacyn's face.
timeline.quote: The world rumbled again, this time under Jace's feet.

timeline.summary: Sorin sheathes his sword and leaves up the stairs as Jace asks what he has done.
timeline.quote: Jace watched Sorin shove his sword into his scabbard and turn away

timeline.summary: Sorin, trapped, watches Emrakul drift across Gavony toward Thraben.
timeline.quote: The horizon was Emrakul.

timeline.summary: Thalia calls on Saint Traft to summon the spirits of the dead, who possess and shield her soldiers.
timeline.quote: It was Traft who called them, and they answered his summons.

timeline.summary: Thalia declines to force possession on those who cannot accept the spirits.
timeline.quote: I can't make that choice for them.

timeline.summary: Thalia's army passes through Thraben's Outer Wall and fights alongside vampires through the streets.
timeline.quote: They were fighting shoulder to shoulder with vampires now, making their way through the streets of the city.

timeline.summary: Olivia stabs Seeta, chief of the Sinpurged, from behind.
timeline.quote: Then she saw a jagged blade burst out from Seeta's chest

timeline.summary: A huge fused angel of flesh, tentacles and feathered wings looms before Thraben Cathedral.
timeline.quote: Drifting in the air in front of the cathedral was a huge abomination formed of twisted flesh, writhing tentacles...and feathered wings.

timeline.summary: Thalia attacks the angel-thing on her gryff and is slashed down, her gryff killed.
timeline.quote: In response, the angel brought its other arm up and slashed a half-dozen finger-claws down her side and across her gryff's flank

timeline.summary: Sigarda arrives and disowns her fused sisters.
timeline.quote: You are no longer my sisters,

timeline.summary: Sigarda slashes her sisters with her scythe but is snatched and being absorbed into the angel-thing.
timeline.quote: But one of those huge, strangely bifurcated arms snatched Sigarda out of the air.

timeline.summary: With Saint Traft's help, Thalia lifts Avacyn's spear and is given glowing angelic wings.
timeline.quote: glowing, translucent wings spread out from her back, the blessing of some unseen angel.

timeline.summary: Thalia drives Avacyn's spear through the angel-thing's back and into its spine.
timeline.quote: she drove Avacyn's spear through feathered wings and buried it deep into the spine

timeline.summary: Sigarda bursts from the dying angel-thing's chest, and the creature falls dead, calling her sister.
timeline.quote: And it followed Sigarda to the hard stone of the plaza below, curling like a dead spider on the ground.

timeline.summary: A vast tentacled thing approaches Thraben as a tidal wave of corrupted monsters smashes into the plaza.
timeline.quote: As it approached, a tidal wave of corrupted monstrosities crested before it, smashing into the plaza and turning the tide once more toward annihilation.

timeline.summary: Liliana watches the Gatewatch head into Thraben from above, with Gared and her raised army.
timeline.quote: Those must be Jace's little friends.

timeline.summary: Chandra unleashes a huge firestorm against the mutated horde, scorching her friends, and the group is trapped in a market square.
timeline.quote: They were trapped in what had been a market square

timeline.summary: Jace has Chandra topple a lattice-scarred tower with two fireballs to block a street.
timeline.quote: Seconds later, the entire structure collapsed, blocking off most of the street

timeline.summary: Nissa begins the planar glyph in the market square while Gideon charges the horde to protect her.
timeline.quote: He roared a challenge as he slashed in a wide circle

timeline.summary: Nissa pulls up three spectral vines to tap the leylines; the third, darker vine strangles her.
timeline.quote: it had managed to wrap itself around her neck

timeline.summary: Nissa cries out and collapses; the glyph goes dark and the plan fails as the horde keeps coming.
timeline.quote: The glyph went instantly dark.

timeline.summary: Chandra refuses to leave: they all walk out together or not at all.
timeline.quote: "Not gonna happen. We're all walking out of here together, or..."

timeline.summary: Liliana's zombie army pours into the square and forms a defensive perimeter around the planeswalkers.
timeline.quote: they parted, formed a defensive perimeter around them, and started pushing outward.

timeline.summary: Liliana appears with the Chain Veil and wipes out the mutated creatures with necromantic energy, rescuing the Gatewatch.
timeline.quote: Liliana floated forth, arms spread wide, the Chain Veil hovering just beyond her fingertips.

timeline.summary: Nissa and Gideon recoil from the Chain Veil, while Chandra defends Liliana as having saved them.
timeline.quote: "That...thing she carries. It's an abomination."

timeline.summary: Jace refuses Liliana's demand to planeswalk away, insisting they can finish the job with her help.
timeline.quote: We need to finish this. We're so close.

timeline.summary: Gideon asks Jace to decide whether Liliana can be trusted, and Liliana asks what their plan is now.
timeline.quote: So tell me, brave heroes, what's your plan now?

timeline.summary: A moonfolk, Tamiyo, flies into the clearing and silently talks mind to mind with Jace while Liliana watches.
timeline.quote: A moonfolk flew into the clearing, her eyes wide and breath short.

timeline.summary: Emrakul unfolds, growing countless tendrils and releasing a wave of power that hits every planeswalker.
timeline.quote: in that shifting Emrakul unfolded

timeline.summary: In Emrakul's presence Liliana wonders whether seeking not to die was the wrong goal, and recalls Josu, Bolas and the Chain Veil as her worst moments.
timeline.quote: she wondered if she had been pursuing the wrong goal

timeline.summary: The Raven Man and the Chain Veil both urge Liliana to flee, frightened of Emrakul.
timeline.quote: Whatever Emrakul was, the Chain Veil wanted no part of it.

timeline.summary: The other planeswalkers collapse under Emrakul's mental assault, except Jace, who casts a spell in response.
timeline.quote: The other Planeswalkers crumpled, all except Jace, who cast some type of spell in response.

timeline.summary: Fueled by rage, Liliana draws deeply on the Chain Veil, pushes back against Emrakul and takes back her zombies.
timeline.quote: She felt her zombies return to her.

timeline.summary: Liliana refuses to be a vessel, silences the Veil and the Raven Man, and prepares to fight Emrakul.
timeline.quote: She shut down the voices of the Veil and the Raven Man both, silencing them abruptly.

timeline.summary: Liliana blasts Emrakul back with necromantic energy, believing she is winning.
timeline.quote: For the first time since blossoming, Emrakul was shrinking

timeline.summary: Liliana's body begins to fail and Emrakul regrows faster than she can blast it, forcing her onto the defensive.
timeline.quote: now it was all she could do to stand her ground

timeline.summary: The Raven Man tells Liliana her death is now the best possible outcome and she becomes afraid.
timeline.quote: You have doomed us both.

timeline.summary: Liliana's zombies are destroyed by the hundreds as she fights only to survive another moment.
timeline.quote: Zombies were destroyed by the hundreds under Emrakul's assault

timeline.summary: The two Jaces merge; learning Liliana is about to die, Jace dissolves the spell and returns to reality.
timeline.quote: Jace dissolved the spell.

timeline.summary: Jace returns to find Liliana unconscious and bleeding, and Emrakul fully unfolded above Thraben.
timeline.quote: Liliana was on the ground in front of him, unconscious, bleeding profusely from multiple wounds.

timeline.summary: Jace links the group's minds; Jace and Nissa tell Chandra that burning Emrakul will not work.
timeline.quote: Trying to burn Emrakul is throwing a torch into the ocean.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo recalls Avacyn's words and says Emrakul cannot be destroyed and must be bound.
timeline.quote: We cannot destroy Emrakul. We must bind her.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo proposes attuning a binding spell to Innistrad's moon and linking it to Emrakul.
timeline.quote: I have a binding spell. A powerful one. I can attune it to the moon.

timeline.summary: Nissa agrees to power the spell because Jace freed her mind from Emrakul's darkness.
timeline.quote: But I owe you, Jace Beleren. I will try.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo begins reading her scroll and Jace fastens a glyph on the moon to Emrakul.
timeline.quote: A glyph flashed onto the moon

timeline.summary: Nissa collapses having drained the leylines, and the spell is about to fail.
timeline.quote: It was not going to be enough.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo, cut off from Jace's mind, reads a second iron-banded scroll, and a flood of mana pours into the spell.
timeline.quote: Tamiyo pulled out another scroll, a long scroll, a scroll with iron bands

timeline.summary: A silver beam from the moon stretches Emrakul toward it until she snaps, folds and collapses to nothing, bound in the moon.
timeline.quote: Emrakul was gone. They had won.

timeline.summary: Liliana, having survived, stares at the moon and curses Emrakul to rot there forever.
timeline.quote: May you rot there forever.

timeline.summary: Liliana resolves to treat powerful friends as better zombies and dreams of her own Gatewatch.
timeline.quote: My very own Gatewatch.

timeline.summary: Gideon asks Tamiyo to join the Gatewatch and she excuses herself.
timeline.quote: Tamiyo shook her head, excusing herself

timeline.summary: Liliana swears the Gatewatch oath to Gideon with calculated sincerity and becomes a member.
timeline.quote: I see that together we're more powerful than we are alone.

timeline.summary: Liliana is now a member of the Gatewatch and sees futures full of promise and ambition.
timeline.quote: She was now a member of the Gatewatch.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo tearfully tells Jace that Emrakul took over her body to read the second scroll.
timeline.quote: It...she...took me over.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo reveals the scroll cast a changed spell that trapped Emrakul herself, leaving them unsure what they did.
timeline.quote: instead it fueled a spell that trapped herself here

timeline.summary: Tamiyo asks if they really won and flies off into the dark sky with no parting words.
timeline.quote: Eventually she rose and flew into the dark sky.

timeline.summary: Jace, alone, recalls the angel's words that it is not her time yet and goes to find a bed.
timeline.quote: It is not my time. Not yet.

timeline.summary: The party reaches the ruined Thraben cathedral and sees it overrun with the undead.
timeline.quote: The groans of the unhallowed dead answer Chandra before any of the others can.

timeline.summary: Kaya's research turns up a book showing the Betzolds being handed a box by a witch, and Arlinn recognizes Worrin Betzold's name as an old bishop.
timeline.quote: The caption labeled them the Betzolds, from Gavony.

timeline.summary: Adeline spots Worrin preaching to a congregation of zombies in the nave, and Arlinn confirms it is him.
timeline.quote: To Arlinn's horror, he seems to be preaching to a gathered crowd.

timeline.summary: Adeline and her cathars charge the horde while Teferi slows the undead and Chandra covers the rear with sheets of fire.
timeline.quote: Two great sheets of flame fly from her hands

timeline.summary: Arlinn questions the undead Worrin about the key, but he only answers with Dennick's name, and she puts him to rest.
timeline.quote: Arlinn gives Worrin the only rest she can

timeline.summary: Gisa writes her brother that she is bored and has exhausted the living of Thraben, wishing for an opponent worthy of her.
timeline.quote: Things have been getting dreadfully dull here in Thraben.

timeline.summary: Geralf tells Gisa that she has only herself to blame and not to contact him again.
timeline.quote: Do not contact me again.

timeline.summary: Gisa smashes porcelain in a tantrum in the cathedral, having secured Thraben by eliminating most of the living after Liliana's zombies took it.
timeline.quote: The plate shattered against the wall

timeline.summary: Wilhelt, a risen ghoul with his own army, marches toward Thraben to win Gisa's love.
timeline.quote: At the head of his column of the dead, Wilhelt marched on Thraben

timeline.summary: Gisa writes Geralf another angry letter complaining that he will not send her anything to do.
timeline.quote: I knew you were my inferior.

timeline.summary: Geralf refuses again to come to Gisa's aid.
timeline.quote: No, I will not come to save you from the fruits of your own machinations.

timeline.summary: Gisa spots an army of the dead led by a rider approaching Thraben and runs to meet it, delighted to have something to do.
timeline.quote: Someone was riding along the road to Thraben.

timeline.summary: Wilhelt reaches the gates and declares himself to Gisa, who does not remember him and tries to whistle him into thralldom.
timeline.quote: Finally, tilting her head to the side, she asked, "Do I know you?"

timeline.summary: Gisa's whistle tries to bind Wilhelt, but he resists and breaks her hold; Gisa retreats behind the gates.
timeline.quote: breaking the tie between them as Gisa's whistle died, choked off in her throat

timeline.summary: Wilhelt breaks through the gates and his army is attacked by swarms of undead birds, then by the dead who surge out of the shops.
timeline.quote: They were halfway down the avenue when the dead surged out of the buildings to either side

timeline.summary: Gisa urges Wilhelt to surrender; he refuses, so she leaves her soldiers to overwhelm his.
timeline.quote: Then she flounced away down the walk, not looking back

timeline.summary: Wilhelt sends a ghoul with a love letter to Gisa, but she seizes the ghoul's mind and reads it.
timeline.quote: A single ghoul ran into the square

timeline.summary: Gisa reads Wilhelt's letter, is offended that he implies she could get his name wrong, and resolves to destroy him.
timeline.quote: She resolved to destroy him.

timeline.summary: Gisa screams and all the bats in Thraben descend on Wilhelt's army, forcing him to flee.
timeline.quote: Then Gisa screamed, and all the bats in Thraben descended.

timeline.summary: Wilhelt vanishes from the battlefield, and Gisa decides to go to her brother.
timeline.quote: Wilham himself was gone.

timeline.summary: Gisa writes to Geralf that she is on her way to him, and Geralf begs her to go anywhere else.
timeline.quote: I am on my way to you now and should be there inside of the sennight.

timeline.summary: With zombie armies marching on Thraben, the Helvault is sundered and Avacyn is released.
timeline.quote: the Helvault was sundered and Avacyn was released.

relations.note: She besieged and took the city to get at a demon.
relations.quote: had besieged and taken Thraben itself, the greatest city on Innistrad

relations.note: She raised the zombies who now fill the cathedral.
relations.quote: Once, Liliana had raised all these zombies to fight against the Eldrazi.

relations.note: She rules the city from the cathedral.

pages_say.description: The city housing the cathedral where Odric works and the place the prisoner will be brought.
The greatest city on Innistrad, which Liliana besieged and took; home of the cathedral where Jace hopes to find Avacyn.
The holy city that Geralf and Gisa besieged with their undead armies.
The holy city where the Lunarch Council sits.
The cathedral where Tamiyo seeks the oldest histories of Avacyn and where Jace and Avacyn clash.
The cathedral where Avacyn was created and where she is destroyed, with a cellar holding a burn scar in the shape of angel's wings.
The city glowing in the distance toward which Jace and Liliana head.
The city where Sorin created Avacyn and toward which Emrakul drifts.
The holy city at the mouth of the River Kirch, to which all the monsters and Thalia's army converge.
The densest city of life on Innistrad, half ablaze and overrun by Emrakul's legion.
The city on Innistrad where the Gatewatch and Liliana's zombies stand against Emrakul.
Where Liliana recalls Gideon cutting down Eldrazi.
The city on Innistrad whose cathedral vaults may hold the Moonsilver key.
A city with buildings bigger than all of Kessig's houses put together.
The ruined cathedral of Thraben, now overrun by the unhallowed dead.
A city taken by Liliana's zombies and now ruled by Gisa, whose cathedral is her throne room.
The city whose Grand Cathedral Arlinn remembers.
The city where Odric allowed horrors to pass.
The high city and seat of the church.
The city Gisa left behind, which had become boring once its living people were gone.
The high city of Innistrad, marched on by zombie armies.
